svg.text: ImageJAI — how a CLI agent talks to Fiji
One local TCP socket on :7746. Short requests get a reply. A long-lived subscription pushes live events back.
Every reply that leaves Fiji passes through the safety gate first.
launched via the ImageJAI plugin panel ▶ button
What lives on each side of the socket
Each column opens the box. The middle column is the part you don't normally see — what ImageJAI actually does inside Fiji.

numpy-side image analysis — work on the pixels in Python, no Fiji round-trip
auto-discovers parameters of any plugin dialog before the agent uses it
finds a vetted YAML workflow that matches what the user asked for

svg.text: fires macro.*, image.*, dialog.*, safe_mode.*, data_governance.* into the JVM
one queue per listening agent — oldest events dropped if an agent falls behind
runs on every outbound reply — pseudonymise paths, scrub OME-XML, tokenise CSV,
wrap dialog text, downsample vision frames, attach _governance block
every command + response appended to AI_Exports/imagejai_audit.csv
Standard · Pseudonymised · On-premises — the gate's behaviour switches by mode
Pseudonymised: real paths never leave Fiji; image-7a3f.lif goes out instead

g.text: runs IJ1 macro · Groovy · Jython — agent writes one of these per step
Bio-Formats · MorphoLibJ · StarDist · TrackMate · CLIJ2 (GPU) · Weka · …
open images, z/t/c slices, calibration, OME-XML metadata
measurements from Analyze Particles, ROI manager, etc.
regions of interest — agent can read, set, save, redraw
GenericDialogs from plugins — agent probes them, fills fields, clicks OK
script + plugin output — agent reads it back to check for errors
all outputs land here next to the opened image — never anywhere else
Fiji emits events while it works
→ event bus picks these up and fans them to every subscribed agent

Execution Helpers: execute_macro, run_pipeline, run_groovy, run_jython, run_script,
